name: Spailpín Fánach
text: An Spailpín Fánach is an Irish folk melody. The phrase means the itinerant labourer. The air won wide popularity across the English-speaking world. Singers fitted countless sets of words to it. One borrowed tune became the marching song about the girl left behind.
